stayOverview: Start with City centre for the easiest first San Francisco stay, then compare Old Town and Waterfront when price, nightlife, quieter evenings or transfer timing matter more than being beside every major sight.
hotelIntro: San Francisco hotel choice is mostly about repeat journeys: use City centre for sightseeing, Old Town for a different local base, and Waterfront or Airport area when views, parking, airport timing or longer stays matter.
rentalCars: Do not rent a car for central San Francisco unless parking and traffic are part of the plan; use one mainly for regional day trips.
